# QR encoder
Project Nayuki QR Code generator, MIT license preserved in qrcodegen.ts and compiled qrcodegen.js headers.
Source: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/blob/master/typescript-javascript/qrcodegen.ts
Documentation and license: https://www.nayuki.io/page/qr-code-generator-library
Retrieved2026-11-24. Compiled locally with TypeScript targetES2015/strict, no network service required at runtime.
Do not remove the MIT notice. No QR service receives room links or identities. SVG is built client-side with four-module quiet border.
